title: Luck & Risk
coreMove: Separate visible outcomes from the hidden mix of skill, luck, and exposure behind them.
sourcePressure: Luck and risk are twin forces that can make similar processes end in praise or blame depending on the final score.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning winners into geniuses and losers into fools based only on the scoreboard.

hook: opening with a generic paycheck scene
opening with a moral lesson about discipline
opening Luck & Risk with a swapped-in personal finance anecdote

exampleSpecs.domain: a vineyard choosing which apprentice's pruning method to praise after a frost
exampleSpecs.audience: a vintner trying not to confuse harvest outcome with skill
exampleSpecs.stakes: the wrong promotion teaches the crew to copy luck instead of process
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the vintner compares the weather exposure of each row before praising the higher yield
exampleSpecs.firstImage: frost-blackened leaves on one side of a sloped block

exampleSpecs.domain: an independent app developer whose launch coincides with a celebrity mention
exampleSpecs.audience: a founder deciding how much of a spike to credit to product decisions
exampleSpecs.stakes: over-crediting skill could lead to a reckless hiring plan
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the founder overlays the download spike with the celebrity timestamp before approving payroll
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a dashboard spike rising beside a social post timestamp

exampleSpecs.domain: a youth chess coach reviewing a tournament upset
exampleSpecs.audience: a coach teaching parents to praise thinking rather than trophy placement
exampleSpecs.stakes: a child could learn arrogance from one lucky trap or shame from one unlucky blunder
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the coach replays the position where the opponent missed mate before discussing the medal
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a chessboard reset to move twenty-three under cafeteria lights

exampleSpecs.domain: a hospital triage team studying two similar emergency-room nights
exampleSpecs.audience: a nurse manager separating good protocol from random patient flow
exampleSpecs.stakes: one team may be blamed for a wait time caused by ambulance clustering
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the manager pins ambulance arrival times beside staffing notes before naming any failure
exampleSpecs.firstImage: colored magnets clustered on an emergency department timeline

exampleSpecs.domain: a seafood wholesaler judging two buyers after a price swing
exampleSpecs.audience: an owner deciding whether margin came from insight or weather
exampleSpecs.stakes: promoting the lucky buyer could distort the next season's purchasing rules
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the owner checks storm closures and auction lots before rewarding the buyer with the best margin
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a wet auction clipboard under a hanging dock light

exampleSpecs.domain: a documentary grant panel reviewing films released during a news cycle
exampleSpecs.audience: a panel chair preventing attention from masquerading as craft
exampleSpecs.stakes: funding could chase timing instead of disciplined filmmaking
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the chair asks reviewers to score the cut they saw before the headline made the topic hot
exampleSpecs.firstImage: screening-room notes beside a breaking-news alert on a phone
